data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of you: state your exact intended catch and any conditions; 18 is welcome even if others pick 10. A fulfilled switch from 10 earns $8,000 extra now. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). At k=25, that's 500 or 100. This risks future income, not a guaranteed long-run gain. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation.
